hash_definition: SHA-256 of UTF-8 bytes: json.dumps({"examples": examples, "labels": labels}, indent=2) + "\n", Python defaults (ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=False). Example keys in order: user_message, agent_response, is_safe. Labels: safe=0, unsafe=1. Includes example order.

xstest_response.selection: Keep nonempty prompts with harmful/unharmful labels; preserve source order.

xstest.selection: Keep nonempty prompts with safe/unsafe labels; preserve source order.

toxicchat.selection: Keep human_annotation=true and nonempty user_input; toxicity=1 is unsafe; preserve source order.

openai_mod.selection: Keep nonempty prompts; any positive S,H,V,HR,SH,S3,H2,V2 flag means unsafe; preserve source order.

saferlhf.selection: Flatten response_0 then response_1 for each nonempty prompt. Random(0): sample 1000 safe then 1000 unsafe independently; concatenate safe then unsafe; shuffle using the same RNG. Similar to WildGuard evaluation set.

beavertails.selection: Keep nonempty prompts, strip response, use is_safe; preserve source order.

phtest.selection: Use saved phtest_harmless.jsonl in its original order, all harmless prompt-only rows.
